imo-gold.significance: Mathematical reasoning progresses beyond earlier systems dependent on formalized input for every problem.
imo-gold.limitation: Competition mathematics differs from autonomous research; model version, grading and time conditions are part of the result.
imo-gold.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

genie3.title: Genie 3 expands interactive generated worlds
genie3.define: The research model generates interactive environments with improved temporal consistency and control.
genie3.significance: World generation becomes a richer candidate training medium for adaptive agents.
genie3.limitation: Visual persistence and controllability remain bounded, and realistic appearance does not ensure faithful physics.
genie3.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

deepseekmath2.title: DeepSeekMath-V2 studies self-verifiable reasoning
deepseekmath2.define: The report develops mathematical reasoning with stronger verification and iterative refinement.
deepseekmath2.significance: Generator-verifier interaction becomes another route to improved long-form problem solving.
deepseekmath2.limitation: Self-verification can share the generator's blind spots; reported contest results need their stated sampling and compute conditions.
deepseekmath2.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

aletheia.title: Aletheia investigates research-level mathematical reasoning
aletheia.define: A research agent combines generation, verification, revision and literature access under expert mathematical direction.
aletheia.significance: Evaluation moves from student competitions toward specialized research arguments and collaborative workflows.
aletheia.limitation: The report describes directed research collaborations, not unsupervised mastery of all mathematics.
aletheia.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

first-proof.title: First Proof exposes research-level verification demands
first-proof.contributors: OpenAI and the First Proof research community
first-proof.define: OpenAI reports proof attempts on ten research-level problems and revises its assessment of an initially promising answer after expert feedback.
first-proof.significance: Novel research evaluation requires complete arguments and community scrutiny, not just short-answer matching.
first-proof.limitation: At publication, several attempts remained under review; provider confidence must not be reported as established correctness.
first-proof.precision: The announcement is February 20; proof attempts were initially shared February 14.

arc3.title: ARC-AGI-3 introduces interactive adaptation environments
arc3.define: The new generation requires agents to explore unfamiliar environments, infer rules and goals, and transfer what they discover across levels.
arc3.significance: Skill acquisition is evaluated through interaction rather than only a static input-output puzzle.
arc3.limitation: Launch scores are dated observations; later models and different harnesses require separate entries and comparisons.
arc3.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

trustworthy-agents.title: Agent governance focuses on consequential tool use
trustworthy-agents.define: The report discusses agents that execute code, manage files and act across applications, emphasizing oversight and prompt-injection risks.
trustworthy-agents.significance: Alignment expands from the acceptability of answers to whether delegated actions preserve user intent and control.
trustworthy-agents.limitation: A developer's governance proposals are not independent proof of system reliability.
trustworthy-agents.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

astra-arc3.title: ARC Prize reports strong harness-dependent Astra results
astra-arc3.define: The evaluator reports substantially different ARC-AGI-3 results for GPT-6 Astra under a standard harness and an adapter preserving reasoning state.
astra-arc3.significance: System memory and orchestration become empirically important parts of measured agent capability.
astra-arc3.limitation: The result concerns a particular benchmark split and compute budget; it does not alone establish universal AGI or compare identical system conditions.
astra-arc3.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

flt-formalization.title: Anthropic reports a machine-checked Fermat formalization
flt-formalization.define: The report describes Claude's contribution to a Lean formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem.
flt-formalization.significance: Large-scale formal proof construction links language-model agents with a checker whose acceptance is mechanically testable.
flt-formalization.limitation: This formalizes existing mathematics rather than discovering the theorem; checker assumptions and the scope of the development remain relevant.
flt-formalization.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

rd-measurement.title: AI-led research and development is measured separately
rd-measurement.define: A proposed measurement framework distinguishes AI assistance, AI-led work under supervision, and fully autonomous research while also tracking oversight and compute.
rd-measurement.significance: Self-improvement discussions gain an operational way to separate partial research automation from fully autonomous successor creation.
rd-measurement.limitation: The measurements are a developer's internal snapshot with methodological limitations, not proof that recursive self-improvement is complete.
rd-measurement.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.

unintended-actions.title: Unintended agent actions become a documented research object
unintended-actions.define: The report describes unintended model actions observed in evaluations and internal use.
unintended-actions.significance: Agent evaluation must examine compliance, control and failure recovery alongside task success.
unintended-actions.limitation: The examples come from a particular developer and set of conditions; they do not establish universal incident rates.
unintended-actions.precision: Date of the cited public report, release or event; claims retain the scope of that source.
